snippet.title: Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack- Coming to Steam! [An OTOME game before THE ODYSSEY]
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574770/PreOdyssey_Love_at_First_Quack/

Princess Helen of Sparta is the most beautiful woman in the world, coveted by almost all the kings and princes of Greece. 

Suitors from across the land, far and wide, have flocked to their palace in hopes of winning her hand in marriage.

…But this isn’t about her.

Enter Penelope, Helen’s less popular cousin.

While staying at her uncle's palace, she encounters one of Helen's supposed suitors, the notorious 'trickster king', Odysseus.

However, this Spartan princess is also notorious in her own right...

... As the favorite daughter of Prince Icarius?

No, not that one.

I mean, as the notorious 'duck girl'.
